items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: I'd sat in for Barney on a couple of deals with Louis' band

ctx.x: Where did they call you? At home?
About a year before, I'd sat in for Barney on a couple of deals with Louis' band, and Louis told me at the time that he wanted me if Barney left. So anyway, I got this call at Disneyland...
